operations.detail: The product contains 11 linked-identifier relationship packages.
operations.source: OS Open Linked Identifiers documentation and technical specification

operations.detail: Each relationship is downloaded as its own ZIP package.
operations.source: OS Open Linked Identifiers documentation and technical specification

operations.detail: Each relationship package includes the linked identifier CSV.
operations.source: OS Open Linked Identifiers documentation and technical specification

operations.detail: Each relationship package includes a product-version JSON file.
operations.source: OS Open Linked Identifiers documentation and technical specification

operations.detail: Each relationship package includes a licence text file.
operations.source: OS Open Linked Identifiers documentation and technical specification

operations.detail: Each relationship package includes a relationship description PDF.
operations.source: OS Open Linked Identifiers documentation and technical specification

operations.detail: Relationship IDs encode both data identifiers, feature identifiers and a correlation type number.
operations.source: OS Open Linked Identifiers documentation and technical specification

operations.detail: The product includes latest version information for referenced features.
operations.source: OS Open Linked Identifiers documentation and technical specification

operations.detail: Latest feature versions can differ from versions used to create a relationship.
operations.source: OS Open Linked Identifiers documentation and technical specification

operations.detail: A version difference can mean a historic relationship is no longer valid.
operations.source: OS Open Linked Identifiers documentation and technical specification

operations.detail: Relationship records use a confidence value to describe version alignment.
operations.source: OS Open Linked Identifiers documentation and technical specification

operations.detail: One confidence state indicates version information matches the feature versions used for correlation.
operations.source: OS Open Linked Identifiers documentation and technical specification

operations.detail: One confidence state indicates version information may differ from the correlation-time feature version.
operations.source: OS Open Linked Identifiers documentation and technical specification

operations.detail: One confidence state indicates version information differs from the feature version used for correlation.

operations.detail: UPRN relationships are refreshed after each six-week AddressBase epoch.
operations.source: OS Open Linked Identifiers documentation and technical specification

operations.detail: UPRN relationship extraction can include live, provisional and historic BLPU records.
operations.source: OS Open Linked Identifiers documentation and technical specification

operations.detail: The UPRN-TopographicArea relationship uses AddressBase cross-reference data to connect TOIDs.
operations.source: OS Open Linked Identifiers documentation and technical specification

operations.detail: The UPRN-TopographicArea extraction identifies the relevant cross-reference source as 7666MT.
operations.source: OS Open Linked Identifiers documentation and technical specification

operations.detail: The UPRN-TopographicArea association is derived using point-in-polygon correlation.
operations.source: OS Open Linked Identifiers documentation and technical specification

operations.detail: GeoPlace performs the address-seed to TopographicArea correlation.
operations.source: OS Open Linked Identifiers documentation and technical specification

operations.detail: AddressBase and OS MasterMap Topography use different release cycles.
operations.source: OS Open Linked Identifiers documentation and technical specification

operations.detail: Different release cycles can temporarily place relationship and feature versions out of sync.
operations.source: OS Open Linked Identifiers documentation and technical specification

operations.detail: The BLPU-Street relationship is extracted by joining BLPU, LPI and Street records.
operations.source: OS Open Linked Identifiers documentation and technical specification

operations.detail: The UPRN-USRN relationship includes BLPU lifecycle states and open roads described by the source.
operations.source: OS Open Linked Identifiers documentation and technical specification

operations.detail: Open Roads GUID relationships map open road features to OS MasterMap Highways RoadLinks.
operations.source: OS Open Linked Identifiers documentation and technical specification

operations.detail: The UPRN-TopographicArea relationship can support linking an address to a building footprint.
operations.source: OS Open Linked Identifiers documentation and technical specification
